title: Tseitin clauses for a circuit
statement: For a circuit on $n$ variables, its Tseitin clauses are defined recursively. For a leaf carrying literal $l$, they are the two clauses expressing that the gate variable for the leaf has the same truth value as $l$. For an internal gate, they consist of the clauses for that gate together with the Tseitin clauses of each child circuit.
